name: Roger's Apple
reason: MeowDB lists no items given on acceptance for Roger's Apple (acceptItems is empty), yet the quest cannot be completed without using Roger's Apple (objectives.item_usage: item 235, count 1) and the canonical completion dialogue says "Eat the Roger's Apple I gave you". Roger must therefore hand the apple over when the quest is accepted. MeowDB does not state the quantity or the timing.

accept_items.name: Roger's Apple
accept_items.reason: Hand-out quantity and timing are not published by MeowDB (gap recorded in game/data/canonical/quests/1002.json). One apple, given on accept, is the minimum that makes the quest completable: the usage objective needs exactly 1 use. The count of 1 is NOT taken from safe-to-sell.json (whose qty is how many the quest asks for, not a hand-out count).

evidence.where: On completion / If you don't have the items yet: "Eat the Roger's Apple I gave you ..."
completion rule "To complete: use Roger's Apple, then talk to Roger."
